title: Comic Strips
text:
Comic strips are short stories with pictures. Most comic strips have three or four boxes. Each box is called a panel. People read comic strips from left to right.

Many comic strips are funny. The characters often talk in speech bubbles. Some comic strips are in the newspaper every day. Ana likes to read them after school.

questions.text: How many boxes do most comic strips have?
Where can some comic strips be found every day?
Why does Ana probably like to read comic strips after school?
options: She has to read them for school

questions.text: What can you guess about the pictures in a comic strip?
options: They help you understand the story
They are the same as photos

vocabulary.definition: one box with a picture in a comic strip
the people or animals in a story
printed paper with news, published every day

paragraph_translations: As tiras de quadrinhos são histórias curtas com desenhos. A maioria das tiras tem três ou quatro quadros. Cada quadro se chama painel. As pessoas leem as tiras de quadrinhos da esquerda para a direita.
Muitas tiras de quadrinhos são engraçadas. Os personagens geralmente falam em balões de fala. Algumas tiras de quadrinhos saem no jornal todos os dias. A Ana gosta de lê-las depois da escola.
